description_en: Queries the price for upgrading or downgrading a monthly subscription (unlimited duration) cloud computer or premium Internet bandwidth
description_zh: 查询按月购买不限时长云电脑或公网精品带宽的变配价格
kebab_example: aliyun ecd describe-modification-price --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id ecd-0gfv2z3sf95zvt0000 --instance-type eds.enterprise_office.8c16g --root-disk-size-gib 80 --user-disk-size-gib 50 --root-disk-performance-level PL0 --user-disk-performance-level PL0 --resource-type Desktop --bandwidth 20 --promotion-id youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank --resource-specs RootDiskSizeGib=80 DesktopId=ecd-6ghhzivgmnzgeyXXX UserDiskSizeGib=100 --reseller-owner-uid 1422724566551 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeModificationPrice

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the list of regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. The value can be the ID of a monthly subscription (unlimited duration) cloud computer or the ID of a premium Internet bandwidth instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，可以是按月购买（不限时长）云电脑ID或者公网精品带宽ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource specification.

If ResourceType is set to Desktop, valid values include:
    - ecd.basic.small
    - ecd.basic.large
    - ecd.advanced.large
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge
    - ecd.performance.2xlarge
    - ecd.graphics.xlarge
    - ecd.graphics.2xlarge
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge_s8d2
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge_s8d7
    - ecd.graphics.1g72c
    - eds.general.2c2g
    - eds.general.2c4g
    - eds.general.2c8g
    - eds.general.4c8g
    - eds.general.4c16g
    - eds.general.8c16g
    - eds.general.8c32g
    - eds.general.16c32g

If ResourceType is set to NetworkPackage, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源规格。

当`ResourceType`为`Desktop`时，枚举值包括：
    - ecd.basic.small
    - ecd.basic.large
    - ecd.advanced.large
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge
    - ecd.performance.2xlarge
    - ecd.graphics.xlarge
    - ecd.graphics.2xlarge
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge_s8d2
    - ecd.advanced.xlarge_s8d7
    - ecd.graphics.1g72c
    - eds.general.2c2g
    - eds.general.2c4g
    - eds.general.2c8g
    - eds.general.4c8g
    - eds.general.4c16g
    - eds.general.8c16g
    - eds.general.8c32g
    - eds.general.16c32g

当`ResourceType`为`NetworkPackage`时，可以不传入该参数
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GiB
parameters.name: root_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB
parameters.name: user_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en: The performance level (PL) of the system cloud disk. You can set the disk performance level when the cloud computer specification in Settings is Graphics or High Frequency. For more information about the differences between disk performance levels, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html. standard SSD and ESSD have different performance levels
parameters.help_zh: 系统盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: root_disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en: The performance level (PL) of the data cloud disk. You can set the disk performance level when the cloud computer specification in Settings is Graphics or High Frequency. For more information about the differences between disk performance levels, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html. standard SSD and ESSD have different performance levels
parameters.help_zh: 数据盘的性能等级。当云电脑规格设置为图形型或者高主频时，支持设置磁盘性能等级。关于各性能等级磁盘的差异，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/122389.html
parameters.name: user_disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. The required parameters vary based on the resource type for which you want to query the upgrade/downgrade price:

If ResourceType is set to Desktop, you must specify the InstanceType, RootDiskSizeGib, and UserDiskSizeGib parameters.
If ResourceType is set to NetworkPackage, you must specify the Bandwidth parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。要查询变配价格的资源类型不同时，必需参数也有所不同：

当`ResourceType`=`Desktop`时，必须传入参数`InstanceType`、`RootDiskSizeGib`、`UserDiskSizeGib`。
当`ResourceType`=`NetworkPackage`时，必须传入参数`Bandwidth`
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The peak Internet bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

If you use the pay-by-fixed-bandwidth billing method, valid values are 10 to 1000
parameters.help_zh:
公网带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。

按固定带宽计费时，取值范围为10\~1000
parameters.name: bandwidth

fields.help_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GiB
fields.name: user_disk_size_gib

parameters.help_en: The list of resource specification templates
parameters.name: resource_specs

parameters.help_en: The resource ownership user ID in the reseller pattern. You do not need to specify this parameter in non-reseller pattern
parameters.help_zh: 转售模式的资源归属用户ID，非转售模式无需填写该参数
parameters.name: reseller_owner_uid

TradePrice.description_en: The actual payment price. The value is the original price minus the discount amount
TradePrice.description_zh: 实际付款价格。取值为原价减去折减的价格
